symbols.name: group
symbols.meaning: The group, a set with an associative operation, an identity element and inverses.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal{G}$ be a group: a set with an associative operation, an identity element $1$, and an inverse for each element.

symbols.name: group element
symbols.meaning: An element of the group whose powers are taken.

symbols.name: order
symbols.meaning: The order of the element, which counts its distinct powers.
symbols.quote: The order of $\chi$, written $m$, is the least positive integer with $\chi^m = 1$.

symbols.name: monomial count
symbols.meaning: The product of the axis lengths, which is the number of target monomials.
symbols.quote: The [Chinese-remainder map](chinese-remainder-map.md) applies this to pairwise coprime axis lengths $t_1, \dots, t_d$, where axis $i$ has length $t_i$ and their product is $S = t_1 t_2 \cdots t_d$, the number of target monomials.

symbols.name: axis variable
symbols.meaning: The variable of axis i, whose powers index the target monomials.
symbols.quote: Let $t$ be the indeterminate of $\mathbb{C}[t]/(t^S-1)$, and let $Y_i$ be the variable of axis $i$.

symbols.name: inverse factor
symbols.meaning: The inverse, modulo $t_i$, of the product of the axis lengths before axis i.
symbols.quote: Each $\mu_i$ is the inverse of $\prod_{j<i} t_j$ modulo $t_i$, which exists because that product is coprime to $t_i$.

symbols.name: Chinese-remainder map
symbols.meaning: The map sending the indeterminate $t$ to the product of the axis variables raised to the powers $\mu_i$.
symbols.quote: The map $\Phi$ sends $t$ to $\prod_i Y_i^{\mu_i}$, the product of the axis variables raised to the powers $\mu_i$.

relations.quote: Within a [cyclic group](cyclic-group.md), the order of an element is read off from the group it generates.
